I found practical templates and real-world examples we could apply to our fundraising strategy for whichever charity we select.

From there, we can finalize our selection based on which option has the highest overall score and meets our group’s priorities. Let’s see if GPT-4o has any last data to share once they finish using the computer. Then we can wrap up the research phase and proceed to a vote.
